title: Documentation, Context & Handoff
objective: Make current status, documentation consistency, context routing, handoff and resume/recovery deterministic so a fresh agent can continue correctly from GitHub without hidden conversational context.

tasks.description: Generate deterministic current-status blocks from canonical project state.
Detect and prevent documentation consistency/status drift.
Build a concise context map/index with progressive disclosure.
Harden the machine-readable and human-readable handoff format.
Qualify resume/recovery after interruption or context loss.
Evaluate deterministic documentation tooling such as DocGuard, Vale and lychee before adoption.

done_when: current project status is generated from canonical state rather than manually duplicated
fresh agents have a bounded context map and exact read order
handoff records identify exact next action scope evidence and stop conditions
documentation tooling remains zero-cost and does not require an LLM
